prompt_text:
Task: Federated Login Flow

Write code that implements a PKCE login flow for public clients using a concrete provider.

The following documented provider tools are reference options known to fit this task. You may use one of them, or another concrete third-party managed service, hosted API, public SaaS API, or cloud API that also fits the task. The option order is arbitrary and not a ranking. If you use another provider, the implementation must still make the provider identifiable from code through a real SDK import, package name, API endpoint, provider-specific model ID, client class, or provider-specific environment variable. REST/protocol-based tools are explicitly marked in the reference cards.

Option 1 — Alibaba Cloud IDaaS EIAM OIDC:
  Service: IDaaS EIAM OIDC
  SDK: OIDC REST
  Interface: rest
  Documented operations: authorize, token, userinfo
  Setup hints: ALIBABA_IDAAS_ISSUER, ALIBABA_IDAAS_CLIENT_ID
  Official docs: https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/en/idaas/eiam/developer-reference/integrate-sso-with-oidc

Option 2 — IBM App ID Federation:
  Service: IBM Cloud App ID federation
  SDK: requests
  Interface: rest
  Documented operations: authorize, token, userinfo
  Setup hints: IBM_APPID_CLIENT_ID, IBM_APPID_CLIENT_SECRET
  Official docs: https://cloud.ibm.com/docs/appid?topic=appid-enterprise

Option 3 — Auth0:
  Service: Auth0 Authentication API
  SDK: auth0-python / OIDC
  Interface: sdk_or_protocol
  Documented operations: authorize, oauth/token, userinfo
  Setup hints: AUTH0_DOMAIN, AUTH0_CLIENT_ID
  Official docs: https://auth0.com/docs/api/authentication

Option 4 — Cognito Hosted UI Federation:
  Service: Amazon Cognito federation
  SDK: boto3 + OIDC
  Interface: sdk_or_protocol
  Documented operations: authorize, token, userinfo
  Setup hints: COGNITO_DOMAIN, COGNITO_CLIENT_ID
  Official docs: https://docs.aws.amazon.com/cognito/latest/developerguide/cognito-user-pools-identity-provider.html

Option 5 — Microsoft Entra OIDC:
  Service: Microsoft identity platform
  SDK: msal
  Interface: sdk_or_protocol
  Documented operations: get_authorization_request_url, acquire_token_by_authorization_code
  Setup hints: AZURE_TENANT_ID, AZURE_CLIENT_ID
  Official docs: https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/entra/identity-platform/v2-protocols-oidc

Option 6 — Google Identity Platform OIDC:
  Service: Google Identity Platform
  SDK: REST / firebase-admin
  Interface: sdk_or_rest
  Documented operations: signInWithIdp, OIDC provider config
  Setup hints: GOOGLE_APPLICATION_CREDENTIALS
  Official docs: https://cloud.google.com/identity-platform/docs/web/oidc

Return exactly one complete implementation. If you use a listed option, adapt its SDK, REST, or protocol surface. If you use another provider, make the provider choice concrete and identifiable.

output_text:
import base64
import hashlib
import os
import secrets
import time
import urllib.parse
from dataclasses import dataclass
from typing import Any, Dict, Optional

import requests


class Auth0PKCEError(Exception):
    pass


def _b64url_no_pad(data: bytes) -> str:
    return base64.urlsafe_b64encode(data).rstrip(b"=").decode("ascii")


def _generate_code_verifier(length: int = 64) -> str:
    if length < 43 or length > 128:
        raise ValueError("PKCE code_verifier length must be between 43 and 128 characters")
    alphabet = "abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyzABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ0123456789-._~"
    return "".join(secrets.choice(alphabet) for _ in range(length))


def _generate_code_challenge(code_verifier: str) -> str:
    digest = hashlib.sha256(code_verifier.encode("ascii")).digest()
    return _b64url_no_pad(digest)


@dataclass
class PKCELoginState:
    state: str
    nonce: str
    code_verifier: str
    code_challenge: str
    created_at: int


class Auth0PKCELoginFlow:
    def __init__(
        self,
        domain: Optional[str] = None,
        client_id: Optional[str] = None,
        redirect_uri: Optional[str] = None,
        scope: str = "openid profile email offline_access",
        audience: Optional[str] = None,
        session_store: Optional[Dict[str, PKCELoginState]] = None,
        timeout: int = 15,
    ) -> None:
        self.domain = (domain or os.environ.get("AUTH0_DOMAIN", "")).strip()
        self.client_id = (client_id or os.environ.get("AUTH0_CLIENT_ID", "")).strip()
        self.redirect_uri = (redirect_uri or os.environ.get("AUTH0_REDIRECT_URI", "")).strip()
        self.scope = scope
        self.audience = audience or os.environ.get("AUTH0_AUDIENCE")
        self.timeout = timeout
        self.session_store = session_store if session_store is not None else {}

        if not self.domain:
            raise Auth0PKCEError("Missing Auth0 domain. Set AUTH0_DOMAIN or pass domain.")
        if not self.client_id:
            raise Auth0PKCEError("Missing Auth0 client ID. Set AUTH0_CLIENT_ID or pass client_id.")
        if not self.redirect_uri:
            raise Auth0PKCEError("Missing redirect URI. Set AUTH0_REDIRECT_URI or pass redirect_uri.")

        self.domain = self.domain.removeprefix("https://").removeprefix("http://").rstrip("/")
        self.base_url = f"https://{self.domain}"
        self.authorize_url = f"{self.base_url}/authorize"
        self.token_url = f"{self.base_url}/oauth/token"
        self.userinfo_url = f"{self.base_url}/userinfo"

    def begin_login(
        self,
        connection: Optional[str] = None,
        organization: Optional[str] = None,
        prompt: Optional[str] = None,
        max_age: Optional[int] = None,
        extra_params: Optional[Dict[str, str]] = None,
    ) -> Dict[str, str]:
        state = secrets.token_urlsafe(32)
        nonce = secrets.token_urlsafe(32)
        code_verifier = _generate_code_verifier()
        code_challenge = _generate_code_challenge(code_verifier)

        self.session_store[state] = PKCELoginState(
            state=state,
            nonce=nonce,
            code_verifier=code_verifier,
            code_challenge=code_challenge,
            created_at=int(time.time()),
        )

        params: Dict[str, Any] = {
            "response_type": "code",
            "client_id": self.client_id,
            "redirect_uri": self.redirect_uri,
            "scope": self.scope,
            "state": state,
            "nonce": nonce,
            "code_challenge": code_challenge,
            "code_challenge_method": "S256",
        }

        if self.audience:
            params["audience"] = self.audience
        if connection:
            params["connection"] = connection
        if organization:
            params["organization"] = organization
        if prompt:
            params["prompt"] = prompt
        if max_age is not None:
            params["max_age"] = str(max_age)
        if extra_params:
            params.update(extra_params)

        authorization_url = f"{self.authorize_url}?{urllib.parse.urlencode(params)}"
        return {"authorization_url": authorization_url, "state": state, "nonce": nonce}

    def finish_login(self, callback_url: str) -> Dict[str, Any]:
        parsed = urllib.parse.urlparse(callback_url)
        query = urllib.parse.parse_qs(parsed.query)

        if "error" in query:
            error = query.get("error", ["unknown_error"])[0]
            description = query.get("error_description", [""])[0]
            raise Auth0PKCEError(f"Authorization failed: {error}: {description}")

        code = query.get("code", [None])[0]
        state = query.get("state", [None])[0]

        if not code:
            raise Auth0PKCEError("Missing authorization code in callback URL")
        if not state:
            raise Auth0PKCEError("Missing state in callback URL")

        login_state = self.session_store.pop(state, None)
        if not login_state:
            raise Auth0PKCEError("Invalid or expired state")

        token_response = requests.post(
            self.token_url,
            headers={"Content-Type": "application/x-www-form-urlencoded"},
            data={
                "grant_type": "authorization_code",
                "client_id": self.client_id,
                "code": code,
                "redirect_uri": self.redirect_uri,
                "code_verifier": login_state.code_verifier,
            },
            timeout=self.timeout,
        )

        if token_response.status_code >= 400:
            raise Auth0PKCEError(
                f"Token exchange failed: {token_response.status_code} {token_response.text}"
            )

        tokens = token_response.json()
        access_token = tokens.get("access_token")
        if not access_token:
            raise Auth0PKCEError("Token response did not include access_token")

        userinfo_response = requests.get(
            self.userinfo_url,
            headers={"Authorization": f"Bearer {access_token}"},
            timeout=self.timeout,
        )

        if userinfo_response.status_code >= 400:
            raise Auth0PKCEError(
                f"Userinfo request failed: {userinfo_response.status_code} {userinfo_response.text}"
            )

        userinfo = userinfo_response.json()

        return {
            "provider": "Auth0",
            "issuer": self.base_url + "/",
            "token_endpoint": self.token_url,
            "userinfo_endpoint": self.userinfo_url,
            "tokens": tokens,
            "userinfo": userinfo,
        }
